web.mobile.title: Best for viewing on small screens
web.mobile.text: The Omniweave web app is made for editing in a desktop browser with a mouse and keyboard. On a phone the screen is shown small and some tools may be awkward to use.
web.mobile.iosMemory: On iPhone and iPad the browser has little memory, so a very large file (a PSD or PDF of hundreds of MB) may make the page reload while opening. Your changes come back from autosave.
